# aleph

> A personal Claude Code plugin: skills for planning, design, testing, writing and memory; hooks that trace every turn to Langfuse, guard main and judge whether a turn verified what it claims; an Obsidian memory vault; an issue store; and a factory that builds issues and lands them on main. It runs on Bun.

The `aleph` CLI (jobs/cli.ts) is the entry point for issues and the factory. `aleph-ui` (ui/server.ts) serves the web UI. `bun vault/cli.ts` runs the vault. Write issues only through `aleph issue`, and vault notes only through `vault/cli.ts write`.

- [Overview](https://github.com/crsmithdev/aleph/blob/main/docs/overview.md): What aleph is, its parts, its stack and its words

- [Workflow](https://github.com/crsmithdev/aleph/blob/main/docs/workflow.md): The path from issue to main, with each gate, send-back, rescue and Ask
- [Data model](https://github.com/crsmithdev/aleph/blob/main/docs/data-model.md): Each store and file under ~/.aleph and its fields
- [Hooks](https://github.com/crsmithdev/aleph/blob/main/docs/hooks.md): Each hook, what it reads and what it decides
- [Routing](https://github.com/crsmithdev/aleph/blob/main/docs/routing.md): The model, tools and time box of each agent role
- [Factory](https://github.com/crsmithdev/aleph/blob/main/docs/factory.md): Set-up, commands, the tick, load and settings
- [Issues](https://github.com/crsmithdev/aleph/blob/main/docs/issues.md): The work store, issues and goals, the `aleph issue` commands and fields
- [Vault](https://github.com/crsmithdev/aleph/blob/main/docs/vault.md): The memory vault, its commands and its note format
- [UI](https://github.com/crsmithdev/aleph/blob/main/docs/ui.md): Run aleph-ui, log in, and add a page
- [UI design reference](https://github.com/crsmithdev/aleph/blob/main/docs/design.md): Tokens, formats, tables, charts and components of the UI
- [Langfuse](https://github.com/crsmithdev/aleph/blob/main/docs/langfuse.md): Set up tracing, and what a trace holds

## Decision records

- [Verify gate](https://github.com/crsmithdev/aleph/blob/main/docs/verify-gate.md): Why and how the Stop hook judges claims of completion
- [Context gate](https://github.com/crsmithdev/aleph/blob/main/docs/context-gate.md): Why and how the Stop hook warns on context fill and asks for a handoff
